name: @hiq-ai/hiq-editor
stderr:
hiq-editor <command>

Commands:
  hiq-editor list                       List stable Editor domain commands.
  hiq-editor doctor                     Verify native bundle or actual SSO and
                                        Editor API access.
  hiq-editor install                    Install this complete native bundle and
                                        selected host Skills.
  hiq-editor install-skill              Copy the expert Skill to another host's
                                        Skill directory.
  hiq-editor installation               Inspect owned runtime and registrations
                                        without Editor API calls.
  hiq-editor upgrade                    Inspect or install a complete native
                                        release.
  hiq-editor uninstall                  Remove owned programs and Skills;
                                        preserve credentials and user files.
  hiq-editor login                      Sign in through the existing HiQ device
                                        flow.
  hiq-editor logout                     Remove stored login credentials.
  hiq-editor describe <command>         Print one command contract.
  hiq-editor call <command>             Invoke a domain command with a JSON
                                        object.
  hiq-editor version                    Print version.
  hiq-editor datasources-list           List Editor datasources available to the
                                        authenticated account.
  hiq-editor processes-list             List processes through the native Editor
                                        workspace API.
  hiq-editor process-show               Aggregate process basics, management
                                        metadata, cores and items into one
                                        readback.
  hiq-editor flows-search               Search Editor flows with stable ids,
                                        type, category and unit fields.
  hiq-editor product-categories-search  Search tenant CPC product categories and
                                        return verified category codes.
  hiq-editor upr-preflight              Inspect one UPR workbook and resolve its
                                        datasource, data items and reference
                                        flow without creating a dataset process.
  hiq-editor upr-import                 Inspect, preflight, import and read back
                                        one official UPR workbook.
  hiq-editor process-trial-calculate    Preflight, trial-calculate and confirm
                                        one Editor process.
  hiq-editor process-submit-review      Verify calculation, submit one process
                                        for review and confirm its workflow
                                        state.

Options:
      --version  Show version number                                   [boolean]
      --json     Emit one machine-readable JSON envelope.
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
  -h, --help     Show help                                             [boolean]

Environment:
  HIQ_EDITOR_TOKEN       SSO token or Cortex task delegation JWT
  HIQ_EDITOR_API_KEY     HiQ API key (mutually exclusive with token)
  HIQ_EDITOR_API_URL     Native API (default: https://x.hiqlcd.com/api/dataset)

Exit codes: 0 ok · 2 config · 3 validation · 4 upstream · 5 transport · 1
